control_flow: followInTheDark: if the right light is below 60 %, use the line tracker (below 90 %: curve left; above 95 %: curve right; between 90 and 95 %: call avoidWalls); otherwise call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if the left light is below 70 %, turn 20° away from an obstacle on the left or right, else call driveInTheDark; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left (10 %, 40 %); otherwise curve right (40 %, 10 %).
